description: Use this when the user wants a few resume bullet points checked without sending the whole resume. Give each resume bullet a score, a verdict and specific fixes with stable codes: weak openers, missing scale or result, numbers that show neither, hard-to-believe claims, first person, vague claims. The same rules and severities as check_resume. Up to 30 bullets of up to 600 characters each; blank items are skipped and reported by index. Rules version 2026-10-24.4.

bullets.description: One resume bullet per item, at most 30.

name: check_bullets
title: Check resume bullets
